Find local licensed captain wage bands or conservative operator wage proxy for each market.
Decide whether USVI/BVI should be modeled as separate country rows or a blended corridor-level reference when a cross-border route is used.
Only then add rows to finance/model/country-reference.json and run partner-model cascade.
